I answered Pree in a thread on her message in #central-random: the ticket is #8841.

That number comes from Tobias's post in #central-random yesterday (Oct 13, 9:27), so Pree can see it herself. He said West yard Door 2 is still double-booking when flatbeds check in early at the kiosk, and that he'd flagged it to support on #8841.

His post calls it "Tobias's dealer account" and doesn't name Marrow Fieldworks. I linked the two through the public Jan 2 Central handoffs digest. It calls Marrow Fieldworks Pree's dealer account and says it changed hands on Jan 5. That suggests Tobias took it over, but the digest doesn't say who got it. So I suggested she check with Tobias before the call. I also told her I can't see the ticket itself, so I don't know its current status.
